audit.why: 53.64% over 481 games with EVEN 5.5/10 and a chart of Skill everywhere except the first-item row is consistent across packet, full and content — a spacing lane that turns the moment you can gap-close.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 why was the generic long-brawl template and gave no reason the row is Skill rather than yours.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 and prevents damage entirely while reflecting projectiles, so a level-6 Purgatory is only a spike once that shield is spent — which is exactly why the row is even and the first-item row is not.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Rebuttal as a poke problem only — 'never poke while it glows' — and then tells you at level 6 to 'open Purgatory' and that your blink gets past the reflect. Locke's R is flagged as a projectile, exactly like his Q, so Rebuttal can reflect the ultimate itself, not just the poke.
audit.why: Throwing a 120s ultimate into a reflect shield is the single most expensive mistake available in this matchup, and the page as written invites it.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, phases[4].why and wants.foe[1], with the 38s rank-1 cooldown attached so the bait has a timer.
